name: Atlantic hurricanes
summary: No Atlantic tropical cyclone listed on 18 Nov; the season ends on 30 Nov
state: GDACS listed only two active tropical cyclones worldwide at 05:41 UTC on 18 Nov, Akvan near India and Xavier near the Cook Islands, and none in the Atlantic basin (GDACS). The Atlantic season formally ends on 30 Nov. With no storm threatening land, the level stays Normal.
for_you: No action needed. Travellers to the Caribbean can check the National Hurricane Center and FCDO travel advice before travel.
rubric_hit: No hurricane active or threatening land = Normal

sources.title: GDACS — Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System

why: Atlantic hurricanes hit the US Gulf coast, Caribbean and Central America — and refinery and insurance markets with them.
drivers: Sea-surface temperatures, ENSO, wind shear, season timing (Jun–Nov peak Aug–Oct).

rubric.alert: Category 3+ landfall expected within 72 hours or occurring.
rubric.watch: Tropical storm or hurricane threatening land within 5 days.
rubric.normal: No hurricane active, or none threatening land within 5 days.
